channel.title: Platform Research And Development - Aziz Kurbanov

item.title: Building an Agentic Kubernetes Platform That Runs Anywhere
item.description: A deep dive into an event-driven, portable agent platform that combines Kafka coordination, Cilium networking, GPU model serving, governed analytics, knowledge graphs, and reproducible AWS, Proxmox, and Kind deployment paths.
item.dc:creator: Aziz Kurbanov

item.title: A Kubernetes Operator for Self-Hosted Cube Core
item.description: How a declarative CubeCluster API, interchangeable Go and Python controllers, storage-aware Cube Store topology, and a Kind telemetry demo turn self-hosted Cube Core into an operable Kubernetes workload.
item.dc:creator: Aziz Kurbanov

item.title: Model Fleet: Declarative GPU Inference, Training, and Agent Operations
item.description: A deep technical look at a Kubernetes operator that converts model intent into standard inference, training, networking, scaling, dataset, GPU-placement, observability, and agent-control resources.
item.dc:creator: Aziz Kurbanov

item.title: robotics-k8s-infra
item.description:
Production-grade platform for cloud/edge robotics integration. Features KubeEdge for edge computing, ROS2 middleware, ArgoCD for GitOps deployment, multi-domain DDS for distributed systems, eBPF-based networking with Cilium for UDP multicast discovery, CLI tools for edge node simulation and lifecycle management, and real-time metrics collection.
